verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is driven through Microsoft Graph, a documented public API with a single endpoint and documented resource operations such as listing users. It also publishes machine-readable $metadata and OpenAPI descriptions, offers the interactive Graph Explorer console, and has an explicit versioning policy with a 24-month deprecation commitment. The probe 404s on learn.microsoft.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the metadata is served at graph.microsoft.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Entra end-to-end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Microsoft Graph API offers a single endpoint, https://graph.microsoft.com, to provide access to rich, people-centric data and insights in the Microsoft cloud
Retrieve a list of user objects.
Microsoft Entra's API surface is Microsoft Graph, whose machine-readable description is published live
